opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary Ulta retail promotion alongside a Carol's Daughter purchase, with the speaker describing the transaction as “This was a very good deal.” The receipt shown with the product identifies a gift-card survey promotion, while the spoken offer is limited to “the first hundred people that come through” receiving a $5 gift card. That language describes a conditional customer promotion requesting participation and an opinion, not a guaranteed return or outcome. The product praise is also expressly identified as unpaid: “I'm not being paid by them to say that.”

citations.quote: This was a very good deal
